og.title: Carpet Cleaning Basics | CARSI
og.description: Carpet cleaning is one of the most common services delivered by restoration and cleaning professionals across Australia. This course builds the fundamental skill of cleaning carpet effectively, safely and in accordance with recognised standards.

faq.q: Who is this carpet cleaning course for?
faq.a: It is written for restoration and cleaning professionals across Australia, whether the work is in a residential home, a commercial office, or a response to an insurance-related water loss.

faq.q: What will I be able to do after this course?
faq.a: You will be able to clean carpet effectively, safely and in accordance with recognised standards. Carpet cleaning is one of the most common services in the industry, so this is treated as a fundamental professional skill.

faq.q: Does this course apply to insurance water-damage work?
faq.a: Yes. The course is framed around the three settings where carpet cleaning is delivered - a residential home, a commercial office, and a response to an insurance-related water loss.
